notes.title: The Mountain DLC Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.7.0 The Mountain![/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
[b]This update brings a new DLC with an all new map, The Mountain! Complete with 4 forage locations, 20+ new cards and an all new unique warmth system.[/b] Priced at 5.99 USD, this map is meant to be a harder survival experience, so working together and communicating is key! I had a lot of fun making this DLC, and I hope you enjoy playing it. As with the Island Curse DLC only the host needs to own The Mountain to play on it. However, the DLC does also include 3 new skins to use, and you will need to own it to use them.

[h3]Final Update and Thank You:[/h3]
[b]I would also like to say a big thank you to everyone who has played the game thus far.[/b] (And thanks for 200 steam reviews!). Working on this game has been a lot of fun and it has been super cool to see people play, leave reviews, make videos, and join in community play events. The game reached a lot more people than I thought it would with just over 40,000 lifetime unique users and hundreds of thousands of views on YouTube. So again thank you <3. That all being said, this will be the last major update for Betrayal Beach. (There may be a few more smaller patches with fixes and tweaks though). I originally only intended to work on it for another 2 months after release but 7 months later here we are. But stay tuned! I'm in the early prototyping phase of my next project and will be announcing it here when It's ready.

There is also now a steam bundle including all 3 DLC for 10% off! Tip for steam bundles: if you already own the other two DLC then buying the bundle will just apply the 10% discount to The Mountain DLC.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48567/Betrayal_Beach_Complete/

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]The Mountain Map[/b]
[list]
[*] Has 4 forage locations: The Cave, Mountainside, Valley and Lake.
[*] New resource Clay. Similar to plants, stone and wood. Used for night events and some crafting.
[*] New resource Kindling. Used for restoring warmth at the campfire.
[*] More new unique cards waiting to be discovered.
[*] New cards, craftables, events, hazards and more!
[*] 3 new skins.
[*] 2 new achievements.
[/list]
[b]Warmth[/b]
[list]
[*] Only on The Mountain Map
[*] Various hazards, night events, or failing to add kindling to the new fire may reduce your warmth.
[*] Lower warmth will reduce your maximum health, freezing over up to 3 slots.
[*] Raising your warmth back up via adding kindling to the fire or a few special cards will return your max health.
[*] When a health slot is frozen if it was full that health will be stored, and can be restored once warmth returns.
[/list]
[b]Misc Other[/b]
[list]
[*] New map tab in game settings used to change what map will be played on.
[*] New 'Useful' card tag, this will count as any resource when added to the stockpile.
[*] Survivor ghosts will now get a 'Useful' card instead of 1 of each resource.
[*] New guidebook page on warmth.
[*] Tabs to quickly swap to rules or roles in guidebook.
[*] Various tweaks, fixes and small details.
[/list]

notes.title: Island's Curse DLC Update 1.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.4.0 Island's Curse Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
Version 1.4.0 brings the Island's Curse DLC among several tweaks and fixes. The DLC is now available for 4.99$ and comes with 7 roles and 9 player skins. To use the new DLC roles in game the host must own the DLC. Only the host needs to own it, so other players can enjoy the new roles without having to purchase it as well. Now onto the patch notes.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Island's Curse.[/b]
[list]
[*] Includes 9 new player skins.
[*] Includes the following 7 roles:
[*] Engineer (Survivor) - Gets a 'Frequency Blocker' card that can be played on totems or caches to prevent saboteurs from using them.
[*] Investigator (Survivor) - Gain a 'Hidden Camera' card that can be played on another player to be notified each time they move to a new location.
[*] Leader (Survivor) - When the Leader is in the game they are publicly marked and are the only player who is allowed to vote for exile.
[*] Cursed (Survivor) - When the Cursed player dies the Saboteur shrine will be set to max level that night instead of resetting to first.
[*] Cannibal (Saboteur) - The Cannibal won't gain any benefit from normal food or healing cards. Each day they may use a 'Bite' card to steal a hunger from another player. Additionally whenever a player dies they will get a 'Flesh' card that they can eat or use to poison the campfire.
[*] Trapper (Saboteur) - Gets a 'Trap' card which may be played at a forage location to trap it. The next player to forage there will be hit with the trap and take a point of damage.
[*] Omen (Saboteur) - Gain a 'Ritual Bones' card which can be played at a forage location to make it treacherous the next day. While treacherous that location's danger level will increase much faster with each forage.
[*] Each new achievement has an associated 'Win' achievement that awards a new seat decoration. You do not need to own the DLC to earn these achievements.
[/list]
[*] [b]Hotkeys![/b]
[list]
[*] Hotkeys for each tab button. (J - Event), (M - Map), (K - Craft), (L - Exile), (N - Notebook), (H - Guidebook).
[*] Hotkeys for emotes. (1-6).
[/list]
[*] [b]Miscellaneous.[/b]
[list]
[*] Rulebook role entries now give a summary of the roles ability.
[*] Can now mark names with specific role icons in the notebook.
[*] Role ability button UI made a little more clear and has a '?' button that can be hovered to see ability description and cooldown.
[*] Notifications sent in text chat now play a distinct sound.
[*] Skin entries in customize menu now have different color borders based on DLC required.
[*] Notification icon is displayed after earning a new seat cosmetic.
[*] End game dead and die to hazard seat material cosmetics changed (they were too similar).
[*] Guidebook tab no longer minimizes at night.
[*] Fixed all 'Win' achievements not actually requiring you to win the game.
[*] Fixed the way roles were picked making it so 'Guaranteed' roles weren't always guaranteed.
[*] Various other small tweaks and fixes.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 7-8 Player Update Version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.3.0 The 7-8 Player Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
The Island is getting a little more crowded with support for up to 8 players in a match. Experience the chaos of arguing about who took the food with 7 other people! This update also includes Steam achievements. And the feature everyone has been waiting for... rock customization! You can now customize your seat with new styles and decorations. These cosmetics start locked but can all be earned through achievements. There is more in this update as well, so be sure to check out the full patch notes below. Thank you for all the continued support, I hope you enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/928bf91ebe6fa2ac5c5727bdc0e420151e16040b.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]7-8 Player Support![/b]
[list]
[*] You can now make lobbies with up to 8 players.
[*] Some locations and UI elements have been tweaked to fit more players.
[/list]
[*] [b]Achievements and Seat Cosmetics.[/b]
[list]
[*] 16 steam achievements have been added.
[*] All seat cosmetics are locked. They can be earned through Achievements!
[*] Two types of seat cosmetic: Styles and Decorations.
[*] Seat cosmetics can be set in a new tab in the customize menu.
[/list]
[*] [b]Ghost Tweaks.[/b]
[list]
[*] Living players can no longer see dead player ghosts.
[*] New game setting that lets living players see ghosts. (In case you preferred the way it was).
[*] Players will now ragdoll whenever and wherever they die.
[/list]
[*] [b]Clients Now See Game Settings.[/b]
[list]
[*] All clients can open the game settings book in the lobby and see what rules have been set.
[/list]
[*] [b]Misc. other tweaks, changes, and fixes.[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved voice reconnection button function.
[*] Various UI and location tweaks.
[*] Changed into ticket sprite from orange to teal.
[*] Volcano exile now hides player and UI when ragdoll is thrown.
[*] All roles now start as won't appear in game settings.
[*] Lockbox will now disappear the day it is opened.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 7-8 Player Update Beta!
notes.notes:
[b]Attention Survivors![/b]
[u]The 7-8 player update is now available for testing on the public beta branch![/u]
New features include support for up to 8 players in a lobby and seat cosmetics. (All seat cosmetics are unlocked in the beta but will be unlocked through achievements upon the updates release). If you participate in the beta please leave feedback in the games discord!

How to activate the beta (all players in group must be on the beta version to play together): 
1. Right click the game in your steam library and select properties.
2. Select the betas tab
3. In the beta participation dropdown list select 'publictesting - Public Testing Branch'
4. The game should update and now be in the beta. The version in game should be B1.3.X.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/928bf91ebe6fa2ac5c5727bdc0e420151e16040b.png[/img]

notes.title: Roles Update Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.2.0 The Roles Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors ! Betray your friends in all new ways in the new Roles Update!
This update includes 5 new roles (3 for Survivors, 2 for Saboteurs). Each role has their own new abilities to mix up gameplay in new and interesting ways. You can control which roles appear and how often in the game settings. Detailed patch notes below, have fun and thank you all for the continued support!

Oh, and the DLC with more roles and cosmetics is still in the works and will be releasing in a couple weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/2bcd631499124aef8befc7d4db5cbb7cec3116f5.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Saboteur ability: See how many players are at each location on your map.
[*] 5 Roles:
[list]
[*] Survivor, Tracker: See how many players are at each location on your map.
[*] Survivor, Thief: Use your ability (3 day cooldown) to get a crowbar, which can be used to open saboteur caches.
[*] Survivor, Marshal: After day 4, use your ability to get a gun, which can be used to kill any player.
[*] Saboteur, Shade: Use your ability (3 day cooldown) to turn yourself and all other players into dark spirits. A Dark Spirit's identity is hidden, and they cannot speak. Useable only during the morning, effect lasts one phase.
[*]  Saboteur, Trickster: Use your ability (2 day cd) to get one of three cards. A snake that will poison food in the campfire and add 2 portions. Tar, which when added to the stockpile, will hide the contributor list. And a card that will turn a single player into a Dark Spirit for the phase.
[/list]
[*] Updated game rules for roles
[list]
[*] Each role has 4 levels that can be set.
[*] Wont show.
[*] Uncommon (30% chance to appear).
[*] Common (70% chance to appear).
[*] Guaranteed.
[/list]
[*] Updated Intro
[list]
[*] New UI that shows team and role.
[*] New visuals for Saboteurs.
[/list]
[*] Updated UI
[list]
[*] Overhauled Crafting UI.
[*] New UI for roles.
[*] Updated discard button and hand count.
[/list]
[*] Local voice volume adjustment for all players in lobby.
[*] Poisoned food rework: When eaten, will now give a random health / hunger value in a range.
[*] Various other fixes, tweaks and changes.
[list]
[*] Food no longer stays in campfire overnight.
[*] Saboteur Cache spawn chance increase
[*] Hand full popup now closes on phase change.
[*] Guidebook page for new roles.
[*] Name will be properly updated in voice popups.
[*] Can no longer join lobbies with a different game version. (And they wont appear in the lobby list).
[*] And more!
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: End of Next Fest and Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors (and Saboteurs).
The Steam Next Fest has concluded. It was super awesome seeing players enjoy the game and getting feedback! Additionally the game hit 500 Wishlists, which is an exciting milestone for me. For those of you who want a little more time with the demo...
[b]The demo will be available until Feb 19th![/b]

Additionally there has been an update to the demo:
[b]Volcano Improvements[/b]
- There are now VFX and sounds when a player hits the lava
- With a new toggleable game setting, roles are revealed on player exile
-- The VFX spawned look different based on the team,  and a message will display revealing the exiled player's team.
-- This can be turned off by unchecking 'Reveal player roles on exile' in the game lobby rules
-- In the case it is disabled all players will spawn the same VFX and the message won't show
[b]Other Tweaks and fixes[/b]
- Survivors now win the morning after all Saboteurs die (as opposed to a full day later)
- Fixed a few bugs with the Volcano
- Fixed a divide by 0 error that caused the game to not end if all players died at the start of a night phase
- Other small fixes / tweaks

If you enjoyed playing the demo or plan on playing it more before the 19th please [i]leave me feedback![/i] This can be done in game, but also on steam discussions, under this post or messaging me on twitter.

notes.title: Demo V0.10.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
I hope everyone is enjoying the demo. (And if you aren't please let me know what to improve!) I have been working on some updates during the week while working on some YT short / Tiktok promo content. The update isn't huge but I think the new exile feature is a lot of fun.
Thanks for playing! Share the demo with friends and leave me feedback in game or wherever, I would love yo hear from you.

[h2]Update Notes:[/h2]
[b]Improved Exile[/b]
- The trial voting phase of exile now takes place inside a new volcano location. If the on trial player is successfully exiled, they are flung backwards into the lava.
- Players can no longer ready during a trial.
- Reduced trial time some.
[b]Night UI Updates[/b]
- Reworked the saboteur night UI to be more similar to the survivor version with a two page book. Night event voting are now elements on a page instead of the cards themselves.
- Night event messages are now animated an pop-up one at a time.
- The game will no longer end upon going into the night phase if the end condition is met. Instead it will wait until after the night recap phase has ended. This way players can get a better understanding of what happened.
[b]Other Misc stuff[/b]
- Seats at each location now fill from inside out, like at the camp
- Player name UI now always faces the camera
- Push to talk has been moved from space bar to C
- Other small fixes and tweaks (+ some stuff I forgot about)
